title: The menu bar menu and the Capture menu call each capture command by the same name
goal: The menu bar icon says Capture Region while the Capture menu in the menu bar says Capture Rectangle for the very same command. One name in both places, so a person who learns it in one menu finds it in the other.
notes: MenuBarMenu in Sources/Photonz/PhotonzApp.swift vs CommandMenu("Capture") in Sources/Photonz/EditorCommands.swift. History items also differ: Show History vs Show Capture History. Pick the shorter menu bar wording unless the Capture menu context needs the noun. Docs listing the menu: docs/design/mocks/shared/PRODUCT-MODEL.md and AGENTS.md.
acceptance: Every command that appears in both the menu bar menu and the Capture menu uses identical wording in both.
The chosen names also appear in the Welcome window and the design study menu lists where those repeat them.
